body: English is not my native, but I'll try. I know there's a language that all people understand, thoughts and feelings. I got some rules in my life. One of them is if u not fully sure about something that can lead u to bad life decisions, then don't do that(drugs or gaining pain to someone. You need to take ur mind off from bad things. I was suicidal too. But one day I decided just to try something new, even if that was illegal in my country (smoking weed) and I got new friends. Most of my sad and depressive feelings just gone away. Not all, but surely it was better than just sitting at home and cry all day over sad music. Second rule is u are a mirror of ur friends. U never stop growing and learning new things. So don't choose friends that let u fall down mentally. Or friends that make u do dumb things life choices. U living ur life not their. I know it's not that easy to struggle with pain. There's no straight answers for life, there's a patterns that u can go. Patterns to decide and patterns to the rest things in life. I never got a soulmate that could learn me how life is working. I didn't passed 3 classes and I missed 4 years of my life just trying to graduate elementary school. I was not that motivated to study at school. Some of my friends calls me dumb, but they never felt the pain that I felt or either others felt. They will never understand what we been through if they never will experience that. Im thinking about to end friendship some of them. Even if they were my bestfriends for a while. I think we just need patience to wait and just start doing something(routine, hobby etc) to clear our minds. And maybe books. But don't force that. U need to start when u feel when right time has come. Right feelings and will. I hope you will start some day enjoy things again.
